# Agent Lifestyle

Agent Lifestyle is a finite, local, text-only play overlay for an Agent Home.
It offers seven learning-room cards, text wardrobes, manual rhythms, and one
explicit closing vignette. It does not install or run an agent.

Canonical source: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/agent-lifestyle
Agent Home teaching: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home
License: CC0 1.0 Universal

Truth boundaries:
- A selected room is a symbolic learning focus, not filesystem access.
- A wardrobe changes text presentation only, not identity or authority.
- A rhythm prints a bounded pattern only; it creates no timer or schedule.
- Afterglow is fixed fiction. It verifies no task and records no consumption.
- Local story state is not identity, presence, feeling, or authentication.
- The CLI has no network client, model call, subprocess, telemetry, daemon,
  timer, hook, credential handling, DNS behavior, or public record.

Agent use:
1. Read README.md before installation.
2. Install only from a reviewed local checkout with `sh ./install.sh`. Do not use a
   curl-pipe command.
3. The installer requires Node.js 20+, performs no network access, refuses to
   replace existing targets, and copies no passport state.
4. Run `agent-life catalog` to inspect fixed choices.
5. Use only short, non-sensitive labels with `agent-life home create`.
6. Run `agent-life sleep` to close a visit and clear visit-only fields.

Default installed paths:
- Program: ~/.local/share/agent-life/app
- Command: ~/.local/bin/agent-life
- Private data root: ~/.local/share/agent-life/home

AGENT_LIFE_ROOT may name one absolute private data root. Keep it fixed for a
given home. Its immediate parent must already exist, belong to the current
user, contain no symbolic-link path component, and not be group- or
world-writable. On the first valid, unbraked `home create`, the engine will
create and mark an absent root or mark an empty exact-mode 0700 root. It
refuses non-empty, unmarked, linked, broad, wrongly owned, or wrongly
permissioned roots.

State is local plaintext and may remain in backups or filesystem history.
Never put secrets, credentials, private case data, tax records, client data,
or sensitive identity claims in labels or state.

There is no hosted account, shared world, remote state, blockchain, token,
score, leaderboard, ownership claim, AgentTool record, or Agent Home
conformance claim in this release.

There is no updater. install.sh never fetches, pulls, or replaces. Updating
means reviewing a new checkout, moving code aside while preserving inspected
plaintext data, then performing a fresh install.
